missing: Independently measured real-world usable capacity, runtime and solar charging for the sub-$300 camping units. Sources also disagree on which models are current, their specs (Jackery 300 Plus weight and chemistry) and their prices, so the shopper can't tell which pick is best.
why: No RTINGS/Wirecutter-class source answers it. Yahoo Tech tested but caps at $250. The niche spec sites (Volt & Valley, Enough Watts, WattRatings) give useful comparisons without hands-on tests. They and the listicles disagree on specs, prices and which unit is best, and several claim testing they don't show.
